in_hebrew.name: Fulvia
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Fulvia הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. In Latin, Fulvia means 'fulfilling' or 'abundant'. This name is derived from the Roman family name Fulvius, which was originally an adjective meaning 'yellow' or 'golden'. In the context of Christian baby names, Fulvia can symbolize the abundance and richness of God's love and grace.
